author: schlormpf
body:
gu ramen in laguna beach - their shoyu shiitake broth is an absolute umami bomb and by far the best vegetarian ramen i've ever found in my life. it's so good that some of my meat eater friends prefer to get that broth and then add chashu lol.

THH sandwiches & coffee in tustin - incredible $7 banh mi, made with perfect crusty baguettes they make fresh in house. their tofu banh mi is insane, they marinate it in something that makes it soooo crazy flavorful before frying it and slicing it up into shreds for the sandwich
